# DSH Isolated Runtime

Kubernetes-only AgentEnvironment on upstream Agent Sandbox core. Start with CONSTITUTION.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/design/environment-contract.zh-CN.md. Implementation: packages/environment-connector/src/runtime.ts. Fixed template: packages/environment-connector/src/template.ts. Launcher: cmd/environment-launcher. Platform installation and authorization live in dsh-multi-tenant. docs/archive is historical, not current behavior.
